result:
All five functions are implemented in `problems.py` and pass my throwaway checks:

- **`parse_duration`** — single anchored regex `(\d+h)?(\d+m)?(\d+s)?` enforces order, no duplicates, no whitespace/garbage/negatives; rejects a match with all groups empty (so `""` and `"h"` fail), and non-strings raise `ValueError`.
- **`luhn_valid`** — strips spaces/hyphens, returns `False` for empty/non-ASCII-digit (`isascii()` guards against `str.isdigit()` accepting Arabic-Indic digits), then doubles every second digit from the right.
- **`flatten`** — recursive walk building a fresh dict; empty sub-dicts contribute nothing, input untouched.
- **`top_k_frequent`** — `Counter` + sort by `(-count, word)`, slice to `k`; `[]` when `k <= 0`.
- **`rolling_max`** — monotonic deque of indices, O(n). 300k elements / window 1000 runs in ~0.13s.
